name: computer-control
label: Computer Control
description: Control this machine's screen, mouse, and keyboard. Each call runs a short list of steps and returns one screenshot, and it stops before a step when the screen or the mouse changed.

system_requirements.notes: Linux: X11 sessions only. Wayland blocks synthetic mouse/keyboard input. The tool returns an actionable error there rather than silently doing nothing. `scrot` backstops screen capture. `xclip` enables the clipboard-paste fallback the `type` action uses for non-ASCII text. macOS: grant the satellite's host process BOTH Accessibility (synthetic input) and Screen Recording (capture) under Privacy & Security in System Settings. While macOS Secure Input is active (some password fields), synthetic keystrokes are silently dropped. Windows: no extra packages needed, but a non-elevated satellite cannot interact with UAC prompts or windows of elevated processes.

skills.description: How to drive the screen, mouse and keyboard with the computer tool: a list of steps per call, when to batch and when to look first, why a list stops, the coordinate space, every action, the zoom, and the platform edge cases.
